## Agivant Product and Feature Updates

This demo profile positions Agivant as an AI services and implementation partner focused on enterprise productivity and automation.

## New Product Launches
- AI workflow assessment package for identifying automation candidates
- Custom chatbot and knowledge assistant implementation services
- Productivity dashboard prototypes for business teams

## Major Feature Updates
- Expanded focus on retrieval-based assistants and document workflows
- Stronger governance patterns for prompt management and review
- Improved rollout playbooks for adoption and training

## Platform Enhancements
Delivery should be assessed through implementation methodology, cloud compatibility, data-security practices, and reference projects.

## Product Deprecations
- Replace generic AI demos with production-ready workflows tied to business metrics

## Regulatory Updates
Review customer-data handling, access controls, auditability, and compliance obligations before deployment.
